Having not taken her oath of office until January 12th, Elvira Salazar did not assume her office of U.S. Representative until that date.

While Salazar did not take the oath of office on Jan. 3 because she was in COVID quarantine, her term commenced on Jan. 3, when all 433 living members-elect who had been certified as the winner were seated.  Similarly, Alcee Hastings's FL-20 did not become vacant on Jan. 3 when Hastings was in the hospital and thus unable to take the oath of office in person.
